name: empire-ts-monitoring
description: Telemetry hub for Empire: a processor that drains a queue broker into SQLite, a web server with a small query API, and a React dashboard. Experimental.

scripts.setup: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix ../server install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix ../../examples/lb-telemetry install && npm run web:install && npm run web:build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
